known_issues: Platform/workflow issue: Attempting to restore/revert workspace to an older snapshot (e.g., Version 66) may incorrectly trigger a build/deploy and consume credits, and may fail to actually restore the intended version.

existing_features.title: After the workspace restore completes, verify the restored workspace against the existing “Version 66 Reset Verification” checklist in frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md and report pass/fail for each checklist section.

new_feature_requests.summary: Restore/reset the current draft development workspace to exactly match snapshot Version 66, discarding any draft-only changes introduced after Version 66, and do so without triggering any new build or live deployment.

projectName: Restore draft workspace to snapshot Version 66 (no redeploy)
